game_title: Type Cast Forge – Crater Lake Edge Trial
game_concept: A logic puzzle set in Mt. Pyre – Crater Lake Edge, the edge of a glowing crater: the lava scout must handle lava imps while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Type Cast Forge: Convert text to numbers with int() or float() before adding, or the forge explodes.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Crater Lake Edge: the edge of a glowing crater
core_gameplay_loop: In Crater Lake Edge, repeat each round: Convert text to numbers with int() or float() before adding, or the forge explodes. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the forge_heat value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the smelter using at most 22 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 22 before the smelter is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 9 (extended tier): Type Cast Forge
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how forge_heat changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against lava imps in Crater Lake Edge.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The smelter reached with actions_used <= 22.
